article.title: SEC matchup features No. 23 Florida taking on Vanderbilt
article.linkText: SEC matchup features No. 23 Florida taking on Vanderbilt
article.story: Vanderbilt (4-6) at No. 23 Florida (6-4), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Florida by 13.5. Against the spread: Florida 5-5, Vanderbilt 4-6. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Florida Offense Overall: 393.5 yards per game (56th in FBS) Passing: 224.6 yards per game (69th) Rushing: 168.9 yards per game (51st) Scoring: 31.3 points per game (42nd) Florida Defense Overall: 354.1 yards per game (63rd in FBS) Passing: 227.4 yards per game (98th) Rushing: 126.7 yards per game (39th) Scoring: 26.2 points per game (88th) Vanderbilt Offense Overall: 330.6 yards per game (120th in FBS) Passing: 228.4 yards per game (64th) Rushing: 102.2 yards per game (130th) Scoring: 21.3 points per game (113th) Vanderbilt Defense Overall: 354.1 yards per game (63rd in FBS) Passing: 220.9 yards per game (84th) Rushing: 133.2 yards per game (51st) Scoring: 28.6 points per game (103rd) Florida is 124th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 45.2% of the time. Vanderbilt ranks 104th on offense, converting on 35.7% of third downs. Vanderbilt ranks 116th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin. Florida is 117th in the FBS with 68.5 penalty yards per game. Vanderbilt is 116th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 89.7% of trips. Florida's red zone offense ranks 31st, scoring on 90% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Florida Passing: Aaron Philo, 1,486 yards, 9 TDs, 5 INTs, 70.0 completion percentage Rushing: Jadan Baugh, 905 yards on 178 carries, 15 TDs Receiving: Dallas Wilson, 483 yards on 38 catches, 3 TDs Vanderbilt Passing: Jared Curtis, 1,880 yards, 8 TDs, 8 INTs, 64.4 completion percentage Rushing: Sedrick Alexander, 360 yards on 91 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Junior Sherrill, 847 yards on 63 catches, 4 TDs Last game Florida beat Kentucky 21-14 on Nov. 14. Philo threw for 119 yards on 16-of-24 attempts (66.7%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 102 yards and one rushing touchdown. Baugh carried the ball 18 times for 69 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for seven yards. Bailey Stockton recorded 34 yards on four catches. Vanderbilt lost 21-6 to Alabama on Nov. 14. Curtis threw for 223 yards on 25-of-40 attempts (62.5%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Alexander carried the ball six times for 27 yards, adding four receptions for 15 yards. Sherrill put up 100 yards on seven catches. Next game Florida plays at Florida State on Nov. 27. Vanderbilt hosts No. 9 Tennessee on Nov. 28.
